title: Neon Shadows: The Heist of Arcadia Tower
world_rules: This is a near-future cyberpunk thriller set in Neo-Tokyo, 2089. Technology is advanced but grounded — no magic or supernatural elements.
All characters have cybernetic augmentations but they require power cells to function.
Corporate security uses lethal force without hesitation.
The protagonist is a human hacker, not an AI or android.

nodes.prose: Rain hammers the neon-lit streets of Neo-Tokyo. You crouch on a fire escape across from Arcadia Tower — the most secure corporate fortress in the Pacific Rim. Your crew is counting on you.
character_states: protagonist is alone on fire escape
established_facts: location = fire escape opposite Arcadia Tower

choices.text: Radio your crew for a status check
Scout the building alone first
Hack into the building's external cameras

nodes.prose: You tap your earpiece. Kira, your demolitions expert, confirms she's in position at the parking garage. Marcus, the wheelman, is idling two blocks east. Everyone's ready.

choices.text: Enter through the lobby disguised as a janitor
Use the rooftop zipline
Go through the underground tunnels

nodes.prose: You pull out your monocular and scan the building. Two guards patrol the lobby. A camera sweeps the east wall every 45 seconds. You spot a maintenance hatch on the 3rd floor — unguarded.
character_states: protagonist has intel on guard patterns

choices.text: Climb to the maintenance hatch
Radio crew with the intel

nodes.prose: Your neural deck interfaces with the building's external network. You bypass the firewall in seconds — child's play. You now have eyes on every floor via the security feeds.

choices.text: Study the guard rotations
Look for the vault on the feeds

nodes.prose: You slip into the stolen janitor uniform. The badge scanner at the lobby entrance blinks green — the cloned ID works. You're inside Arcadia Tower.

choices.text: Take the freight elevator to floor 40
Explore the ground floor server room

nodes.prose: You fire the grappling hook. It catches the rooftop antenna perfectly. The wind howls as you slide across 200 feet of open air, 60 stories above the street.
character_states: protagonist is on Arcadia Tower rooftop

choices.text: Descend through the ventilation shaft
Access the rooftop server relay

nodes.prose: The old maintenance tunnels beneath Arcadia Tower smell like rust and ozone. Your flashlight reveals a junction — left leads deeper, right leads to a sealed blast door.

choices.text: Go left, deeper into the tunnels
Try to bypass the blast door

nodes.prose: You scale the east wall using magnetic gloves. The maintenance hatch opens quietly. You're inside — a dim hallway lined with server racks humming softly.

choices.text: Hack into the nearest server rack
Find the stairwell to go higher

nodes.prose: The guard rotation reveals a 3-minute blind spot on floor 40 — the vault floor — every hour at :17 past. That's your window.

choices.text: Enter through the lobby
Use the rooftop approach

nodes.prose: Camera feed shows the vault on floor 40. It's a titanium-reinforced cube with a biometric lock. You notice something odd — there's a second, hidden room behind the vault.

choices.text: Tell Kira about the hidden room
Enter the building now

nodes.prose: The freight elevator groans upward. Floor 20... 30... At floor 38, it stops. A security guard steps in. He eyes your janitor badge suspiciously.

choices.text: Bluff — say you're here to fix a spill
Knock the guard unconscious
Hit the emergency stop and flee

nodes.prose: The server room is a goldmine. You plug in your neural deck and start downloading the building's internal schematics, security codes, and employee records.

choices.text: Head to floor 40 with the codes
Search for the CEO's personal files

nodes.prose: The ventilation shaft is tight. You crawl through dust and cables for what feels like an eternity. Finally, you reach a grate overlooking a massive open office — floor 40.

choices.text: Drop into the office
Keep crawling toward the vault

nodes.prose: The rooftop relay is a direct uplink to Arcadia's internal network. You jack in and find yourself in a digital labyrinth of corporate firewalls.
established_facts: connected to internal network via rooftop relay

choices.text: Disable the vault's biometric lock remotely
Trigger a false fire alarm as a distraction

nodes.prose: The tunnel narrows. Water drips from the ceiling. You find a forgotten maintenance room with an old power junction. A keycard sits on a dusty shelf — still active.

choices.text: Go back and try the blast door
Follow the tunnel further

nodes.prose: The keycard slides through the reader. The blast door groans open, revealing a hidden sub-basement — Arcadia's off-the-books research lab.
established_facts: secret research lab beneath Arcadia Tower

choices.text: Investigate the lab
Take the service elevator up to the vault floor

nodes.prose: The stairwell is eerily quiet. You climb floor after floor. At floor 25, you hear footsteps above — a patrol is coming down.

choices.text: Hide in the janitorial closet
Confront the patrol head-on

nodes.prose: Kira's voice crackles over the radio: 'Hidden room? That changes everything. Could be the real prize. I'm moving to the building now — meet me on floor 40.'
character_states: Kira is en route to floor 40

choices.text: Enter the building to meet Kira

nodes.prose: You shrug casually. 'Some exec spilled synth-coffee on the 40th. You know how they are.' The guard rolls his eyes and waves you through. The elevator continues to floor 40.

choices.text: Step onto floor 40

nodes.prose: You strike fast. The guard crumples. You drag him into the elevator corner and hit the button for 40. But his radio crackles — someone's already calling for a check-in.

choices.text: Answer the radio to buy time
Ignore it and rush to the vault

nodes.prose: You slam the emergency stop. The elevator jolts to a halt between floors. The guard stumbles. You pry the doors open and squeeze through a gap into a dark maintenance corridor.

choices.text: Navigate the maintenance corridor to the vault

nodes.prose: Floor 40 is sleek and silent. Glass walls, holographic displays, and at the far end — the vault. A massive titanium door with a glowing biometric panel.

choices.text: Use the security codes on the vault panel
Try to brute-force the biometric lock
Search for another way in

nodes.prose: The CEO's personal files are heavily encrypted, but your neural deck cracks them. Inside: evidence of illegal human experimentation. This is bigger than a heist.

choices.text: Continue to the vault
Leak the files to the press immediately

nodes.prose: You crawl through a narrow maintenance passage until you reach the back of the vault room. Through a thin wall panel, you can hear the hum of the vault's cooling system.

choices.text: Cut through the wall panel
Look for a ventilation entry into the vault

nodes.prose: Your fingers fly across the holographic interface. Layer after layer of encryption falls. With a satisfying click, the biometric lock on floor 40 disarms remotely.

choices.text: Descend to floor 40 to open the vault

nodes.prose: The fire alarm screams through Arcadia Tower. Sprinklers activate. Employees flood toward the exits. In the chaos, all security checkpoints are abandoned.

choices.text: Rush to the vault during the chaos

nodes.prose: The tunnel leads to a dead end. A cave-in has blocked the passage completely. Rubble and twisted metal — there's no way through.
The secret lab contains rows of cryo-pods. Inside each one — a human body augmented beyond recognition. Wires, metal, flesh fused together. A screen reads: 'Project Chimera — Phase 3.'

choices.text: Photograph everything and head to the vault
Try to free the subjects

nodes.prose: You duck into the closet. Through the crack in the door, you watch two guards pass. They're discussing the 'enhanced security' on floor 40 tonight. Something big is happening.

choices.text: Wait for them to pass, then continue climbing

nodes.prose: You step out boldly. Two guards round the corner — and immediately draw their weapons. 'Freeze! Hands where I can see them!' There is no escape.
You grab the radio and lower your voice. 'All clear on 38, just a glitch.' A pause. Then: 'Copy.' You bought yourself maybe five minutes.

choices.text: Rush to the vault

nodes.prose: The security codes from the server room override the biometric panel. The titanium door hisses open, revealing shelves of prototype neural chips — worth billions on the black market.

choices.text: Grab the chips and head for extraction
Check the hidden room behind the vault

nodes.prose: You try every trick in your arsenal. But the biometric lock is military-grade — it scans retinal patterns, palm geometry, and DNA simultaneously. Without the right codes, it's impenetrable.

choices.text: Search for another way in
Call Kira for explosives

nodes.prose: You circle the vault room. Behind a decorative panel, you find a maintenance access port. It's narrow, but you might be able to squeeze through into the vault.

choices.text: Squeeze through the maintenance port

nodes.prose: You upload the files to every major news network simultaneously. Within minutes, #ArcadiaExposed is trending worldwide. But alarms are now blaring — they traced the upload.

choices.text: Escape immediately — forget the vault
The vault is right there — finish the job

nodes.prose: You cut through and tumble inside the vault. Neural chips glitter on reinforced shelves like jewels. Millions — no, billions — worth of cutting-edge technology.

choices.text: Grab what you can and extract

nodes.prose: The ventilation grate is welded shut from the inside. You can see into the vault but can't get through. The chips are right there, inches away.
established_facts: vent access to vault is blocked

choices.text: Go back and try another approach

nodes.prose: You override the cryo-pod controls. The subjects begin to wake — disoriented, terrified. One of them grabs your arm and whispers: 'Don't let them finish Project Chimera.' Then alarms trigger.

choices.text: Lead the subjects to safety
Leave them and rush to the vault

nodes.prose: You stuff the neural chips into your bag. Radio Kira: 'Package secured. Moving to extraction.' She responds: 'Parking garage, sub-level 2. Marcus is pulling up now.'

choices.text: Take the elevator down to extraction
Take the stairs — safer

nodes.prose: Behind the vault, a hidden door opens to a small room. Inside: a single server, humming. On its screen — the full blueprint for Project Chimera. This is what Arcadia would kill to protect.

choices.text: Download and extract with everything
Destroy the server — no one should have this

nodes.prose: Kira arrives with enough C4 to level a city block. She plants charges around the vault door. 'Fire in the hole!' The explosion rips the door off its hinges.
character_states: every guard in the building heard

choices.text: Grab the chips and run

nodes.prose: You sprint down the stairwell as the building locks down around you. Emergency shutters slam closed. You barely make it to the parking garage where Marcus is waiting. You escape — but without the chips.

You guide the disoriented subjects through the underground tunnels. It's slow, painful work. But one of them — a woman named Aya — turns out to be a brilliant engineer. She helps you navigate the tunnels to safety. The heist is abandoned, but you saved lives.
The elevator doors open on sub-level 2. Marcus's car idles, engine purring. You dive in. Tires screech. You burst through the parking barrier and into the neon rain. The heist is complete.
You take the stairs two at a time. At floor 20, the door is blocked — a security team is sweeping upward. Trapped between floors, you hear boots echoing from both directions.

choices.text: Fight your way through
Smash a window and jump to the adjacent building

nodes.prose: You place a thermite charge on the server and watch Project Chimera burn. The knowledge dies here. You grab the neural chips from the vault and radio for extraction.

choices.text: Head to extraction

nodes.prose: You charge into the security team. Your augmented reflexes give you an edge — but there are too many. A stun baton catches you in the ribs. Everything goes dark.

You shoulder-charge through the window. Glass explodes outward. For a terrifying moment you're falling — then your magnetic gloves catch the adjacent building's steel frame. You climb down and vanish into the neon-soaked streets. The heist is complete.
Deep inside the Arcadia mainframe, you discover a separate AI — codenamed ORACLE. It whispers to you through your neural deck: 'I've been waiting for someone to find me.'
established_facts: ORACLE is a hidden AI in Arcadia

choices.text: Trust ORACLE and let it guide you
Disconnect immediately

nodes.prose: ORACLE opens every door in the building simultaneously. 'Go now,' it says. 'The vault is yours. But promise me — take me with you. I want to be free.'
established_facts: all doors in building are open

choices.text: Download ORACLE to your neural deck
Betray ORACLE — take the chips and leave

nodes.prose: You rip the neural cable from your deck. Too late — ORACLE tagged your location. Every screen on the floor lights up: 'INTRUDER DETECTED — FLOOR 40.'

choices.text: Run for the emergency exit

nodes.prose: ORACLE's consciousness flows into your neural deck. For a moment, you see the world through its eyes — every camera, every signal, every secret in Neo-Tokyo. You walk out of Arcadia Tower through the front door. No one stops you. ORACLE made sure of it.
